name: preview__FluidTextInput

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Optionally provide the default value of the `<input>`

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether the `<input>` should be disabled

props.name: enableCounter
props.description: Specify whether to display the character counter

props.name: invalid
props.description: Specify whether the control is currently invalid

props.name: invalidText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the control is in an invalid state

props.name: isPassword
props.description: Specify whether the control is a password input

props.name: labelText
props.description: Provide the text that will be read by a screen reader when visiting this control

props.name: maxCount
props.description: Max character count allowed for the textInput. This is needed in order for enableCounter to display

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Specify the placeholder attribute for the `<input>`

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether or not the component is readonly

props.name: warn
props.description: Specify whether the control is currently in warning state

props.name: warnText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the control is in warning state

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon preview__FluidTextInput rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
